note_on_type: This is NOT an amendment. Amendments change spec parameters (sample_start, boundary, min_n) and lev_spec_amendment_1.json is write-once by design — editing it to bolt on hashes would destroy the exact property that makes it worth anything. This is a separate, additive, write-once provenance record. It changes no parameter.
scope_and_honest_limits: These hashes were computed on 2026-08-02. They are a FORWARD tamper-detection anchor: from this date on, any change to the rule file, the frozen spec, or the amendment is detectable by re-hashing. They are NOT retroactive proof that the rule existed in this form on 2026-07-14 — a hash written today cannot certify a past date. The evidence for the past is different in kind and is stated under 'why_the_boundary_is_checkable_without_trusting_dates'.

lev_sitting.py.role: f_rule — the implementation that produces the boundary

lev_spec_frozen.json.role: cached result of f_rule — NOT the source of truth
lev_spec_frozen.json.note: Lived only on the VM until 2026-08-02, when it was copied to the repo as backup hygiene. Its loss was never an evidentiary risk: the boundary regenerates from setup_log.db under f_rule.

lev_spec_amendment_1.json.role: sample-start amendment (Stage B eligibility floored at 2026-07-27)

cohort_snapshot.method: VACUUM INTO on the live WAL database, never stopped, never modified
cohort_snapshot.note: Not in git (*.db is gitignored). See _db_snapshots/SHA256SUMS.txt.

why_the_boundary_is_checkable_without_tr: semis 0.37 / qqq 0.47 is a deterministic function of (date, lev_sent_semis, lev_sent_qqq) over rows dated <= 2026-07-23 — signal-time covariates, written once, never backfilled (forward-only rule). Recomputed 2026-08-02 from the live DB AND independently from the off-VM snapshot: 13/13 day-medians match lev_spec_frozen.json to the last digit, n_rows 362 matches, boundary reproduces exactly. So the number does not rest on anyone's timestamp; it rests on the cohort plus the stated rule. What reproduction does NOT establish is that the rule FAMILY (median of day-medians, semis primary, tie <= -> LOW) was chosen blind — that rests on lev_sitting.py being committed 2026-07-14, ten days before frozen_at, and on Stage B never having run (--unblind has never passed its N>=50 gate; N was 3-4 at freeze and is 0 after amendment 1). Both of those live in code and history under the author's control. Called what it is: discipline with a code trail, not third-party certification.
what_this_record_does_not_cover: No external/third-party timestamp exists. The GitHub push receipt for 65e32a1 is server-side and not author-settable, but its retrievability decays with the events API retention window — do not build on it.

The two setup_log.db.bak files (2026-06-21, 2026-07-07) are pre-cohort fossils, not a snapshot chain. Both predate the lev columns (deployed the evening of 2026-07-07, commit d2d318a). They can falsify a rewrite of rows before Jul 7 and say nothing about the 362-row cohort.
As of this record the cohort exists in two domains (GCP VM, this Mac). There is no off-site third copy.
